hook_stat.sub: Nett across India on its second Friday — the highest ever

stats.label: Hindi total nett after nine days

diaspora_bullets: Nitesh Tiwari's epic stars Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sai Pallavi
A 12% drop signals word of mouth, not opening-weekend curiosity
news_summary: Ramayana: Part One collected approximately Rs 47 crore nett across India on its second Friday, the highest second-Friday figure recorded at the Indian box office, according to Pinkvilla's trade estimates.
payoff: A 12% second-Friday drop is the pattern of a film carried by word of mouth.
